SECTION: FMRCT01 §0B and §22 — evidential levels, frozen BEFORE the first world
THE_INTEGRATED_EVENT_HAS_NEVER_BEEN_OBSE: MRCI01 established this from bytes: FMRT01 never observed a post-removal turnover (its hold was 250 steps against a shortest observed daughter age at turnover of 871) and FDOT01 never removed a parent. There is no retrospective count of the integrated event to report, and none will be invented.

K = 0.permitted: the fully integrated causal event was not observed in this prospective sample
K = 0.forbidden: any inference of architectural impossibility. Absence at a derived rate of about 1 in 84 is expected to happen sometimes.

K = 1.permitted: one prospectively frozen causal parent-to-daughter event was observed in which a distinct daughter organiser remained functional after selective parent removal and across constituent turnover
K = 1.forbidden: the word replicated, in any form. One occurrence is an observation.

K >= 2.permitted: the prospectively frozen causal parent-to-daughter event was independently reproduced in multiple fresh blocks
K >= 2.forbidden: reading the result across to the architecture as a general capacity

THIS_CHANGES_NO_PHYSICAL_ENDPOINT: MRCI01 derived K >= 1 as the qualification standard because the null is structurally zero. That standard is unchanged. §0B only makes the WORDING track the number of independent fresh observations, so a single occurrence is never called a replication.
NO_SILENT_UPGRADE: a minimal reproduction EVENT is never restated as a self-reproducing organism, and no positive result may imply strong self-reproduction, multi-generation closure, heredity, evolution or living status.
